senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;פָּרַר; cmp. פַּיִיס , פִּיסָא; v. Halévy, Revue des Et. Juives XIV, p. 289 sq.) [piece, division,] lot.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 149b:10">Sabb. 149ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>חולש</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 14:12">Is. XIV, 12</cite>) <he>שהיה מטיל פ׳ וכ׳</he> he used to cast lots on the nobles of his kingdom to find out &c.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:11">Esth. R. to III, 7</cite> <he>בתחלה הפיל פ׳ בימים</he> first he cast the lot on days (of the week); <he>הפיל פ׳ ביום אחד בשבת</he> he cast the lot as to the first day of the week; a. e.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 16b">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>יהי רצון שתַּשְׁכֵּן בפוּרֵינוּ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>שתִּשְׁכּוֹן</he>) may it be thy will to cause to dwell in our lot (that in our lot may dwell) love and brotherhood &c.; (Ms. M. <he>בפוריינו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.); Y. ib. IV, 7ᵈ bot. <he>שתשכן בפוּרְיֵינוּ</he> (from <cite ref="Q00344"><he>פּוּרְיָא</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>פּוּרִים</he>, <cite ref="Q00281"><he>פּוּרִין</he></cite>.

Yalk. Num. 785 they did not come spontaneously, אלא פ׳ שהטילו עליהן but lots were cast for them; a. e.—Esp. Purim, the festival commemorating the delivery of the Jews of the Persian empire from the massacre with which they were threatened through the machinations of Haman.
<cite ref="Megillah 7b:8">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>סעודת פ׳</he> the festive meal of Purim.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 106b:18">B. Mets. 106ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מגבת פ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M00107"><he>מִגְבָּה</he></cite>; a. fr.
